functions.description: video playback setup with background load
functions.notes: Size-exact; 35 bytes left at two sites. (1) +0x1b4: bitfield RMW of background byte 0x1c uses r2 and add r0,sp,#0x24 is hoisted above it; ROM uses r0 and forms &background after the strb. (2) +0x1f4: AllocateArray0204af38(&bg,5,&alloc) emits add r2 before mov r1,#5; ROM keeps r1 then r2. Tried with no change: colorsweep --apply (80 compiles), pointer local, local struct holding both objects, function-scope declarations, inline helpers, do-while block, nested bitfield struct, 1-element arrays, shared palette/priority local, pointer round-trip, and reading palette as the argument. A ctor/dtor wrapper class for SafeAllocator (the ROM calls ResetAllocatorPointer twice and has GetSignedAllocator/Destroy at scope end) OVERGENs by 0x14 because the ctor/dtor are emitted out of line.
